title: 4-men-rescued-after-being-lost-at-sea
description: Four men on the fishing vessel, Prosperity are shown being rescued by crewmembers of the tanker vessel Lamentin Sunday, Jan. 20, 2013, west of Guadeloupe Island after being lost at sea for six days. An HC-130 Hercules aircraft aircrew from Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, Fla., located the fishing vessel and deployed a radio, an emergency position indicating radio beacon, and food and water to the disabled vessel. U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Clearwater
